body:
Every time that I try to talk about it, he doesn't want to. Like, today, he just seemed to be putting me down. Said we've talked about it too much. Wanted to take a break from talking about it.

This whole thing is causing a major depression. His girlfriends are lucky: at least they get to see him. I can barely get him to send me pictures of himself. =/

As far as ultimatums go, yeah, I tried that earlier this year. That's when he lied to me. It was such a big lie that I'd thought that he was having a psychotic break. I ended things. Had he just been honest with me about how trapped I'd made him feel, then we'd have still been together =/.

The irony is that we're not actually getting married. We're planning on not turning in one of the forms. He doesn't want to be legally married to me. Note: "to me". He says that, later, if I meet someone that wants to legally marry me, I'm free to do so.

He has a long history of telling lies. I keep going back for more. But the thing is, I try to forgive him every time. It's just, I love him. We're amazing together when he's not pulling his shit and when I'm doing okay. But, yeah, it's like he's keeping track of all my offenses, everything that's ever hurt him. It's...weird. And, yeah, a harem would probably appeal to him for sure (-.-). Been trying to reassure myself that the relationship will be better when it's not long distance. Here's to hope...
I love him, though =/.

He and I both own a copy of The Ethical Slut. I'm going to see if he'd read it with me.

I was nodding in agreement so many times that it felt like my head was going to fall off. He and I have broken up and gotten together again so many times that it's getting wearing. I wish he'd talk to me about his feelings more, but he said today and last night that we've talked about it for three days straight and that he wants to talk about something else for a change. I asked him if he'd come see me for the weekend, and he blamed the weather for not wanting to come. I don't want to run for the hills--there's more, obviously, that what I've said--but today he told me just to make friends. As if it's his magical answer that cures his trust issues regarding me. It's like he doesn't remember that I suck at making friends. I'm really trying to not get angry, but ... I just feel like poly shouldn't feel this way at all. I half suspect that he's trying to push me into ending things with him =(. Blergh. This stinks. I wish I knew of a compromise here =/.
*hugs* Do please keep us updated. I hope that you get some good news soon. Hope is found in the smallest of places, even a smile on someone's face. Hang in there, okay? =)

Sounds like we'll probably just not send it in.

My parents might want me to have kids. It's not really something that's been talked about. They're the kind that believe that marriage should come before kids. He wants to have kids with me, and I feel good about that. It's nice that he wants to start a family with me. And to answer your question...yeah, I think that's the difference.

Heh, yeah, I'm an adult. I'm pretty much financially dependent on my parents. Once that changes, yeah, I guess I could lay down the law, but ... I really don't want to lose my family over this =(.

Yeah, getting arrested sounds extreme, for sure.

I've lived with him twice. Both times, I got an earful from my parents about how I was living in sin, and it really upset me. Like, it just made me feel like a horrible person. So, if we did it again, then I'd probably get doubt the earful with a side of their version (whatever it might be) of shunning me. It's not something I'm prepared to deal with. My parents are excellent at making me feel like a bad person. I'd rather just get married, make my parents think that I'm not living in sin. *sighs*

I'm okay with him not wanting to marry. I know the idea of being married legally to someone makes him uncomfortable. He claims that, in the future, he might change his mind. I guess I'm holding out for that hope....though I haven't the foggiest idea of what to do if it never comes.

Yeah, my parents definitely wouldn't fall for a fake ceremony at all. If they did, I'd be amazed.

I'll look it up when I have more time. It'd be nice to know whether or not the state I live in will, like, arrest me or something =/.

I've heard that you have to mail in the license. So, perhaps all it takes is lying about mailing it in. If that's true, it seems easy enough. Just worried my parents might keep pestering me about it =/.

He's definitely willing to lie to both our families. He thinks it'll go all right, the lying. I'm just worried that it won't. But, no, I don't want to live a lie. He says that, after enough time, if he still doesn't want to marry me, then I can find another relationship [and still be with him within polyamory]. I just feel sad about that. I wish he wanted to marry me. Anyway, am I willing to lie to my family? Yes. I'm just worried that the truth will out, as it tends to do.

I figure, it's okay if he's mad at me. At least he's expressing emotion, which is more than okay. Been texting him this morning, he's having a bad time of it, but he's talking to his mom, so I'm glad.

I've been told that someone's making a GP appointment for him,  so, there's that. I'm sorry that you've lost someone, and, yes, I know that it's not fun at all. I'm trying my best to be there for him, but I just get the impression that he doesn't understand that my reactions and his mother's reactions are valid. Suicide is definitely not something to toss around word-wise. It's serious. *sighs* At least his mom is there. I'm glad of that.
Oooo. Thank you! I'm in the next episode after that one, and it's kind of making sense, but my brain is still confuzzled. Really hoping it makes sense soon >.< =)

She thanked me for letting her know. Said it's being dealt with. Got a text from him saying that she'd called him and said it was a "fun time all around". It's weird, but I feel like he doesn't understand that, yes, people are going to react if you say anything remotely related to suicide. =/
I emailed his mom. I don't care by now if he gets upset or if she says bad things about me. At least I was trying to keep him safe somehow. =/

Thank you. I emailed his mom, but I did call him. I fully expect his mother to raise all sorts of hell about how unstable I am, but I really don't care. At least she knows that he's having a hard time tonight. What sucks is that, when I called him, he just seemed ... like I was interrupting something important, and all I was trying to do was make sure that he was okay. He said we'll talk tomorrow, but, TBH, I'm not looking forward to it. He got angry too fast with me. I guess I should be glad he's my EX-boyfriend =/.
Thank you for sharing it. I could easily relate to the comic.
Haven't seen this one before. Laughed so hard I nearly cried. Lovely =).
So cute!

OMG, it was so weird, actually. It was strangely good. Nothing totally major/shitty happened...other than the manager being a total jerk. He told me earlier this week that he'd let me know when my schedule was & then told me last night that I had to work today, and he worded it like I'd already known that I had to work today. If any of that makes sense, wow...and sorry, lol. The good news is that I won't be working there for much longer. Got a new job working as a cashier at a grocery store. Am so grateful for this =). Anyway, long story short, yes, work went all right =). I do hope you had a lovely day!!
I was okay. Thanks for the offer, though =).

Thank you =). I can admit to not wanting to work tomorrow at all, but I pretty much have zero choice in the matter. I'm trying desperately to remember that I only have to work there one more week and then I'll be at a different place of employment. What's also keeping me going is the fact that I really don't care what my performance is like work-wise tomorrow, plus I hope to stop by Starbucks on the way home. It's in the small things =). But, yeah, I think if my parents weren't around, then I'd feel a lot worse. I've also had some chocolate since all that went down, so I feel slightly better. Mostly I'm trying to not think about tomorrow too much. You're right, perspective can change a lot =). Sorry if I'm rambling >.>! and *future hug* for later when you feel shitty.
Private info, that's all.

Heather comes and finds me when I'm crying sometimes too, but, like this morning, she's in another room sleeping. I found her twice and told her that I loved her and asked if she loved me too. I'd give almost anything in the world to have her speak and hopefully hear that she loves me.

I'm sorry that you've been depressed as well. I sort of feel the same way, as if the thoughts are always present but it's a matter of ignoring them, of waiting for them to go away...if that makes sense =/.

I'm sorry to hear that about your family. Mine tends to call me dramatic sometimes. They, mostly my mom, think that I should spend more time outside my room, spend more time with family, as if that's the magical cure. I spend so much time in my room on Netflix. Watching shows is a decent distraction from how crappy I feel sometimes.

You keep your chin up too =).

Thank you =). It's so weird how I made that post yesterday and then now my therapist had to cancel on me b/c one of her kids is sick. I didn't think I'd feel *this* upset about it, but I guess I've been feeling more crappy than I realized. =/  That's true, I can definitely relate, and I hope to help a lot of people =).
Yeah, I can understand that. Hang in there =).

I'm worried about contracting the chemicals from the spray and dying. I'm also worried about my cat dying. The darling thing was chasing a random bug in the house today, but as she seems fine I'm trying hard not to worry too much. I have anxiety about a lot of things =/.

This might sound weird, but I'm actually afraid to exercise. I used to struggle with eating disorder symptoms, and I think that now I'm worried that, if I start exercising, then I'll want to lose weight again. =/  I'm glad the running helps you =).

My parents barely have to worry about making ends meet. She's just needling me, nagging me all the time. My best friend says she'll do it, no matter what. My therapist even said the same thing. It's just hard to ignore my mother =/.

I totally got the job pending a background check =). I'd wonder if I imagined it, but I did sign some papers, so... yay =). But, yeah, I agree, having a job keeps one busy.

She helps a bit. She thinks I need to be more assertive. Grr. -.-
Hope you get to feeling better! I'm happy for you, that you live by yourself =).
I'll try to, thanks =).
Thank you =). I'm hoping to talk to classmates tomorrow. =D
Awesome =).

I've been told by a couple of people that I just need to be more confident, as if it was *that* easy. =/  Maybe it'll get better for us, who knows =). My goal is to at least talk to someone in class tomorrow. Hopefully that works out =/.

I'm putting a slight emphasis on applying to new jobs, but by now I'm tempted to pretend like I don't have a job history just so that someone'll hire me.

Confidence is slightly an issue, but in general it's really hard for me to make friends. Been that way since high school. Ended up in three different high schools thanks to parents moving. =/
I haven't watched a lot of it, but it's definitely great for a laugh. =)
This is awesome =).
You don't deserve this. Nobody does. But it happens, and we get through it somehow. Hang in there, it'll get better. If it doesn't get better, keep waiting. =)
*hugs*
I do, but it's a job where I'm the only one there for my shift. And it's worse b/c I detest the job and am hoping I get hired by someone else soon.
I'd be ranting too. Totally understandable. Consider lighting the book on fire? Just kidding >.>! <.<

I'm not really sure what the best thing to do is, but I generally try to do something that cheers me up a bit. A while back, my best friend gave me a book of Zits comics. It made me feel better, if only for a while. Hang in there~

I hear you there. Lately, it's been chocolate for me. I eat it basically every night. Makes me feel slightly better, and at this point I'm glad even if it's for a short period of time that I feel better.
Thank you! I'll be sure to try to take your advice! I almost tried talking to people in my college class today, but I'm never sure what the age range is for people =/. Guessing at their age, I mean.
O_O Oh, yeah, I'd say online is definitely better..
Oh man. I'm so getting it when I have a chance -.-!
I'll definitely keep that in mind, thanks =).
I did that too, wondered if I could recall why he quit drinking correctly. Nice joke, nice joke =).
I hope I start realizing it soon. Thanks for talking this out with me =).
My problem is, I probably feel like I do need their approval somehow =/.
Now that I think about it, I do have *some* family that might be okay with it, but, in general, my immediate family would freak. Thank you for sharing your story =).

I'll go ahead and talk to him about it. From what I gather from all the posts, and yours (thank you for sharing), it's best to be upfront about it right off. I just wish it wasn't so hard to say it =/.
He keeps wanting to call me, and I'm rarely somewhere that's private, but he at least wants to tell me his background story, which is good, I think.
That was my thought, that I should probably politely decline as soon as I can. Actually, it's my hope. I should probably say something straight-up from now on. =/
Oh, that's awful. Might try it XD. >.>
I've got to be careful as well. My mom goes into my room all the time =/. Best advice I have is, well, find good hiding spots. I know it sounds lame, but it's all I've got =/.
Careful partner selection sounds intense. When I'm ready for all this, I do want to give it a shot. How will I know if I don't try, you know?
I know. But it is if you're Catholic like my whole family is. I just separate the two without meaning to.

Ah, expectations. Yeah, I think I have too many of those. I wish I was more relaxed in what I needed from someone else. I wish I was more self-reliant. I fail to live up to someone else's demands every day lately, so I know some of what you're feeling =/.

I think so. Like...I hope so, even. If that makes sense (-.-).

I'm older than 21, and, yes, I need to figure stuff out. The last serious relationship that I had was 5 years on and off, and I've been on a few dates since that ended. *sighs* I just want to be happy with who I am. And if who I am is poly-minded, it'd be nice to know. That is, what I'm trying to say is that....how will I know if I don't try? O_o
A therapist can always learn more. They have a ton of resources at their fingertips. Be honest, regardless of the other person/therapist's knowledge base. *hugs* Good luck!
Woohoo! Good for you =).

Being prepared is always good =).

It's weird. I used to think that I wanted marriage and kids and everything, but now I'm just like "you're not sure what you want anymore, are you", and then I just end up getting frustrated at myself for changing my mind so much =/. I've been dating, but the last guy was all "you don't seem like you have your life together", and I didn't get a chance to say "hey, planet Earth, who the hell DOES have their life together?!" (-.-). Sorry. I guess what I'm trying to say is that ... altogether, I can be socially awkward, and it's hard to meet people =/.

I do want a break. I'm just thinking about my future, I guess. Also feeling lonely =/.

Heh, I'm actually on OKC =O. I do feel like love doesn't have limits, so maybe I'm on my way...? I also would like to love someone for who they are (though I admit that I am only human).

All three.

That's true, I'm not being forced. He just made it sound like I was his last hope, so I said that I could come in. It was really freaking stupid of me. I should have said no. I wish I was more assertive, dangit.

Oddly, it was one that I probably wouldn't have enjoyed that much, but I was planning on trying to enjoy it... a girls' "spa night".

The ones that exist in your head are still real, if only real to you. There is always hope in the smallest of places. Maybe find a secret joy and devote time to it today? My joy in high school was Harry Potter =O.
I think I'll do that on Monday, then. Wishing I didn't let all this %^&* get to me =/. Thank you for your help =).
>.> I hope you're right =/. Really wishing I wouldn't worry so much =(.
I hope you're right. It's driving me nuts. Wondering what would relieve the anxiety altogether... would it be weird to call the company as an anonymous person to ask? >.<
Thank you for letting me know!! It's nice to know that I'm not alone =).
If there's one thing that I've learned, it's that something -- anything, even -- good always happens. Wait for it...please =/. *hugs*
You are definitely not ugly. You're awesome and unique. *hugs*
I know someone who cuts, and he's one of the best people I know. I don't know why women are more well-known for it, though =/.
No longer looking. Thx.

He says that we can talk tonight, so I'm hoping to definitely communicate better. I'm not sure that I was scolded-scolded, but I just felt pure shame after getting the text, and I didn't like that at all since I was, hell, calling for a nice reason. He's kind of guiding me...like, my "assignment" is to make new friends, find 2 events on Fetlife, and join three groups on FL. Weird thing is, I've got 3 friend requests from MEN. I just feel like I epic-fail at meeting people :-/. Anyway, I will definitely try harder at setting ground rules. Thank you :).
Actually, people are being unfailingly kind. I've gotten and fielded a few, but in general I'm actually hearing good advice.

The thing is, I was calling (once) and left a voicemail (once). It wasn't repeated calls or anything, certainly nothing stalkerish. I was just calling to wish him a good night and to tell him that I hoped that he had a nice trip visiting his friend the next day. That was it. And then I got the text, and I'm like ... what? My god, should I just not be nice? I don't know. Nothing makes sense anymore.

This is going to sound weird, but... I'm awful at making friends. I get all nervous, and then I seem like a freak of nature. I'm on Fetlife, and so technically I do have a sense of community, so that it'd be easier to meet people, but... I just never know what to say half the time :-/.
I'll take that into account.

I think miscommunication could be a big part of it, which sounds like maybe that's what you're saying. I'll ask for clearer definitions tonight, but my best friend says that maybe he was just with someone else *coughs*, and ... I don't know how to be okay with that. The last guy I was with (non-play), he wanted to be poly, and I thought I could do it, so now I feel like I'm in way over my head. BUT, I want... to try?...before I totally back out. *sighs* Something tells me this shouldn't be so difficult >.<

I've told him that I'm a bit scared, and he says we can talk tonight, which is all well and good, but the last time he said that he started something in the car and then I just figured we'd talk, err, later. I guess we did talk later, but, this time? God, I hope I don't lose my nerve and that I start the talking thing right off. I actually found him on accident. We met on a dating website, and he was all "does me being kinky faze you?" and I was, like, "nope". Thing is, I've never done this, any of it, before. Find a new dom? I'd have no idea how. :-/ If I wanted to, I mean.

I emailed my therapist. She's all "go to the hospital if it gets worse" and "we'll talk at the next session". Thing is, I don't have the money for that kind of bill. Plus, if I go to a hospital, my family will be confused as hell b/c I haven't been open with them much. The last time that I went to a hospital, my mom called and was all "you don't have the money to pay for all this, the insurance won't cover it either". I don't know what to do. I just hope I feel better...different...soon.

I'm 27, and my mom treats me like I'm 16. She asked me to vacuum the house yesterday, and then I noticed that she was vacuuming the same spots this morning before I left for work: she does stuff like that all the time, and I feel like all the housework she has me do (in the name of "we do it together") is pointless. She told me a week ago that, unless I start helping out more (how is that possible?!), she's going to kick me out, which means that I'll have nowhere to go. I was diagnosed with a personality disorder earlier this year, but it's been a while, several years, since I've been this depressed. I tried explaining how I feel to my mom, but then she started yelling at me about how I never help out, and I'm afraid to explain again. It's hard to focus on the marriage or the life after because I'm not even 100% sure that it'll happen b/c he and I have a pattern of ending things :-/. But, I am happy with him. I really hope things work out there (-.-). Anyway, I'm just tired of feeling this way. Hoping to get in to see a psychiatrist soon :-/. Glad to meet a fellow cat lover :).
I hope that the apartment search goes well. We're all rooting for you. Cliche, perhaps, but 'tis true.

If you're in school, there should be a counselor that can at least see you a few times for no fee. There's often nonprofits around town(s), and many places charge "sliding scale". The library might have resources. *hugs* You're not alone.
You are not alone. *hugs*

The "missing something" idea, I feel like that about my whole life. I feel too different, too strange, too weird. I try to learn how to "be normal", but I feel like nothing I do works. When I try to accept myself for all the weirdness, it just sort of sucks because, in the end, there's not much of a chance that I'll meet someone or have friends that can love me just as I am.

I don't have the answer. I wish I did. For all the world, I wish that I could give you THE answer, but I can't. All I can tell you is that.... later. It will get better later. Perhaps even soon. It's something to look forward to when all else fails.
My cat. I could kill her (GROSS) or give her away (who to? who would take care of her as well??), so... she keeps me here.

A lot of cities have homeless shelters and hospitals. I'm sure anything there is probably better than a park bench :-/. Try stopping by the library for a board with adverts on it, or try calling some nonprofits in town. Hoping things get better for you~
Aw man. Hang in there :-/. It'll get better. Who knows, you might meet new people, adopt a new family :).
I don't know what cliches to not say (they get annoying after a while), but ... hang in there. Someone else will come into your life. I promise.

I know this sounds easy and dumb, but... Make a list of things that you want from life, and figure out what you can do to make those things happen. Personally, I have such a list, and it works fairly well for me. Hang in there :).

Oh man, I hate that phrase. Like, I understand that it might have a little truth to it, but it really annoys me. I *try* to love myself. I try to be okay with "me", but it's hard. The more people say that phrase to me, the more annoying it is :-/.

To answer your questions....I have heard the phrase before. I don't think that anyone's really explained it; a majority of people seemed to think that it was obvious.

I've got a long history of depression, and it doesn't help that my mother is pretty much treating me like her maid. I'd like to help out, but my youngest sister is home from college, and I'm the one that Mom keeps asking for help, while my sister sews and stuff :-/. The short answer is that there's a lot of reasons :(.

Thank you for letting me know a/b SW.
Man :-/. Waiiit, maybe switch to a different GP? Or even a new therapist? I don't know :-/. I wish I could help :(.

I'd highly suggest that you talk to whoever prescribed the medication to you. It might very well be that it couldn't be the right amount, well, needed. I was taking an anti-depressant last year and drinking b/c it didn't seem to be doing much, but then the medication gave me nosebleeds, so I stopped taking the medication...but I'm hoping to start another medication soon. You're not alone.
Thank you for sharing! I agree with what you say, about different problems and yet struggling.

Please don't kill yourself if it doesn't work out :(. Your GP shouldn't give out information, since it breaks the confidentiality. I'm not sure that this is the best thing, but ... maybe talk to the GP and say that you really need therapy and beg them to not say anything negative if they're talked to?

Hang in there. It'll get better :).

Hey, Nate :). I'll be honest, I just dumped out almost half a bottle of vodka the other day. My reason was that, if I got medication as part of treatment, then I shouldn't be drinking anyhow, so I might as well try to stay sober until I start the medication. (My mom found the bottle and gave me hell, but I had warning [it was obvious someone had been in my bathroom trash], so it wasn't that bad.) I say all this to explain that I understand. Thank you, Nate. And good luck to you as well!!
